text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-007","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N10","page":1,"quote":"MATERIAL: DELRIN"}],"comment":"The part is titled 'PUSHER BLOCK 2' (a pusher block typically transmits mechanical force), yet the specified material is Delrin, an engineering plastic with relatively low strength and wear resistance compared to metals. If this block is subjected to significant pushing loads or abrasive contact, Delrin may deform or wear prematurely. The designer should verify that Delrin's mechanical properties are adequate for the actual service loads, or change the material to a suitable metal or higher-performance polymer.","recommended_correction":"Confirm the applied loads justify Delrin; if not, update note N10 and the title-block material field to a stronger, more wear-resistant material."}]}
